description: Krwotok, a living fountain of dark blood: a thick column of glossy crimson blood gushing up out of nothing and splashing at the top into a gaping round mouth with sharp teeth, two arcs of spurting blood curving out like grasping arms ending in claws of droplets, an abstract eerie creature, not a person, no face, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, the creature alone, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
